meta.name: Ziren Lexicon (full reporting-register normalization dictionary)
meta.description: Complete content-word lexicon of the Ziren reporting register, derived from classification_dataset.csv. Hybrid two-layer normalization: 'canonical' = within-language readable surface form; 'lemma' = cross-language concept key linking Waray/Cebuano/Tagalog/English forms of the same meaning. Pure grammar particles and personal pronouns are excluded by design.

layers.lemma: canonical -> lemma (cross-language concept; the classifier feature that links languages).
layers.incident_concept: optional target-side tag on incident-signal entries (MEDICAL/CRIME/VEHICULAR_ACCIDENT/ACCIDENT/FIRE/NATURAL_HAZARD, with hazard_subtype).
layers.negation: negation:true marks a negator that must survive normalisation -- predict._negated() reads these words, so dropping them inverts a signal.

meta.coverage_policy: All content words with freq>=2 are included. Pure grammar particles/pronouns are intentionally excluded (see grammar_excluded). Curated entries have a checked lemma+gloss+register; register:'uncurated' entries are auto-extracted and need a native-speaker gloss/lemma pass (verified:false).
invariants: no canonical is also another entry's variant (idempotent)
surface forms unique across the lexicon

source_legend.seed: added, not yet in this dataset
source_legend.split: separated out of a merged entry in 0.4.0; the frequency was not recounted

lexicon.note: incident_concept is a hint only: natumba covers a person, a tree, a post or a motorcycle falling over, and only the last is vehicular.

lexicon.gloss: none / there is none. NOTE: identical to the language name; never read this surface as a language tag
